Name: nofox PandaHotPotRestaurant
Author: nofoxii
Description:
Hello everyone!😄

Senior Sister has opened a hot pot restaurant in Pelican Town!
Hurry and come support the shop! As for kidnapping the panda and using bath water as the hot pot base... Let Master deal with Senior Sister! I'll go reserve a seat and start eating first~

This mod is a farmhouse retexture that offers two distinct variants: a spring, summer, and autumn version, as well as a winter version!Eating hot pot while snowflakes are falling in winter is absolutely amazing~

❕：This mod uses the AT Template (Alternative Textures).
Please purchase a paint bucket from Robin to use it!

🌟🌟I've also created a matching clothing mod! Feel free to visit my mod page to download and use it alongside this one!
